---
title: "Match Review Report"
subtitle: "Side-by-side candidate comparison for human adjudication"
format:
  html:
    theme: readable
    toc: true
    toc-location: right
    toc-depth: 2
    toc-title: "UEIs in this report"
    embed-resources: true
    page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
params:
  data_path: "../data-dev/EVAL-FRAME-1502-MERGED.csv"
  decision_filter: "MAYBE"   # "ALL" | "YES" | "NO" | "MAYBE" (comma-separate to combine, e.g. "MAYBE,NO")
  only_missing_gt: false      # TRUE = only UEIs whose ground-truth EIN is NOT among the candidates
  max_ueis: 10                # cap number of UEI sections rendered; 0 or NA = no cap
  seed: 42                    # sampling seed when max_ueis truncates the pool
  enable_voting: true         # FALSE = read-only report (no Yes/No/Maybe controls)
  vote_endpoint: ""           # paste your deployed Google Apps Script /exec URL here (see dev/match-review-voting-SETUP.md)
  blind: false                # TRUE = hide ground-truth highlighting/badges for unbiased vote collection
---

```{css, echo=FALSE}
/* ---- Match Review Report styling ---------------------------------------- */
body { margin-left: 4%; margin-right: 4%; }
h1, h2 { color: sienna; }
h3, h4, strong { color: teal; }

.summary-grid { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:14px; margin:18px 0 34px; }
.summary-card { flex:1 1 150px; border:1px solid #e2e2e2; border-radius:10px;
  padding:12px 16px; background:#fafafa; }
.summary-card .n { font-size:1.9em; font-weight:700; color:#333; line-height:1; }
.summary-card .lbl { font-size:.82em; color:#777; margin-top:4px; }

/* UEI block */
.uei-block { border:1px solid #e6e6e6; border-radius:12px; padding:4px 20px 20px;
  margin:34px 0 46px; background:#fff; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.05); }
.uei-head { display:flex; align-items:baseline; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px 16px;
  border-bottom:2px solid #f0e6dc; padding-bottom:8px; margin-bottom:6px; }
.uei-head .uei-name { font-size:1.25em; font-weight:700; color:sienna; }
.uei-head .uei-id { font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace; font-size:.9em;
  color:#666; }
.uei-head .uei-conf { font-size:.82em; color:#777; }

/* status banners */
.banner { border-radius:8px; padding:9px 14px; margin:10px 0 4px; font-size:.92em;
  border-left:5px solid; }
.banner b { font-weight:700; }
.banner.miss    { background:#fdecec; border-color:#c0392b; color:#7d211a; }
.banner.expected{ background:#f3f4f6; border-color:#8a8f98; color:#454b54; }
.banner.undet   { background:#fff7e6; border-color:#d99311; color:#8a5d09; }
.banner.found   { background:#eaf7ee; border-color:#2e9e57; color:#1d6b3a; }

/* candidate card */
.cand { border:1px solid #e6e6e6; border-left:6px solid #d9d9d9; border-radius:8px;
  margin:16px 0; padding:6px 16px 14px; background:#fcfcfc; }
.cand.gt { border-left-color:#2e9e57; background:#f7fcf9; }
.cand-head { display:flex; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px;
  padding:8px 0 6px; border-bottom:1px dashed #e0e0e0; margin-bottom:8px; }
.cand-head .ttl { font-weight:700; color:#444; }

/* badges */
.badge { display:inline-block; font-size:.72em; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.02em;
  padding:2px 8px; border-radius:20px; text-transform:uppercase; }
.badge.gt      { background:#2e9e57; color:#fff; }
.badge.pick    { background:#2d6cdf; color:#fff; }
.badge.yes     { background:#2e9e57; color:#fff; }
.badge.no      { background:#c0392b; color:#fff; }
.badge.maybe   { background:#d99311; color:#fff; }
.badge.flag    { background:#eef1f6; color:#3a4657; border:1px solid #d3d9e4; }
.badge.veto    { background:#c0392b; color:#fff; }
.badge.soft    { background:#e0872a; color:#fff; }
.badge.neutral { background:#eee; color:#555; }

/* the matching form */
table.mf { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; margin:0 0 4px; font-size:.9em; }
table.mf th { text-align:left; color:#8a8f98; font-weight:600; font-size:.82em;
  border-bottom:2px solid #ececec; padding:4px 10px; }
table.mf td { vertical-align:top; padding:5px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid #f2f2f2; }
table.mf td.sec { color:teal; font-weight:700; font-size:.82em; white-space:nowrap;
  width:120px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.02em; padding-top:8px; }

.fld { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:1px; }
.fld .fn { font-size:.68em; color:#adadad; font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace; }
.fld .fv { color:#222; }
.fld .fv.empty { color:#c4c4c4; }
.fld .fv.mono { font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace; font-size:.92em; }

/* similarity / score bars */
.bar-wrap { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
.bar { flex:0 0 60px; height:7px; background:#ececec; border-radius:4px; overflow:hidden; }
.bar > span { display:block; height:100%; }
.bar-num { font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-weight:600; font-size:.9em; }
.sc-hi { background:#2e9e57; } .sc-mid { background:#d99311; } .sc-lo { background:#c0392b; }

@media print {
  .uei-block { break-inside:avoid; box-shadow:none; }
  .cand { break-inside:avoid; }
}

/* ---- voting UI --------------------------------------------------------- */
#vote-bar { position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50; background:#fff; border-bottom:2px solid #f0e6dc;
  display:flex; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px 16px; padding:10px 4px; margin:0 0 8px; }
#vote-bar .who { font-weight:600; color:#444; }
#vote-bar input[type=text] { padding:5px 9px; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:6px; font-size:.95em; }
#vote-bar button { padding:5px 12px; border:1px solid #cbb; border-radius:6px; background:#faf6f2;
  cursor:pointer; font-size:.88em; }
#vote-bar button:hover { background:#f2e8df; }
#vote-progress { flex:1 1 180px; min-width:160px; }
#vote-progress .bar { height:9px; background:#ececec; border-radius:5px; overflow:hidden; }
#vote-progress .bar > span { display:block; height:100%; background:#2e9e57; width:0; transition:width .2s; }
#vote-progress .lbl { font-size:.8em; color:#777; margin-top:2px; }

.vote { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin:10px 0 2px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.vote .vote-q { font-size:.82em; color:#777; margin-right:2px; }
.vb { border:1px solid #cfcfcf; background:#fff; border-radius:6px; padding:3px 12px; cursor:pointer;
  font-size:.85em; font-weight:600; color:#555; }
.vb:hover { border-color:#999; }
.vb.yes.on   { background:#2e9e57; border-color:#2e9e57; color:#fff; }
.vb.no.on    { background:#c0392b; border-color:#c0392b; color:#fff; }
.vb.maybe.on { background:#d99311; border-color:#d99311; color:#fff; }

.uei-vote { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:12px 0 2px;
  padding-top:10px; border-top:1px dashed #e0e0e0; }
.uei-vote textarea { flex:1 1 320px; min-height:38px; padding:6px 9px; border:1px solid #ccc;
  border-radius:6px; font-family:inherit; font-size:.9em; resize:vertical; }
.save-uei { padding:6px 16px; border:1px solid #2d6cdf; background:#2d6cdf; color:#fff; border-radius:6px;
  cursor:pointer; font-weight:600; font-size:.9em; height:38px; }
.save-uei:hover { background:#215bc4; }
.save-status { font-size:.85em; color:#2e9e57; font-weight:600; align-self:center; }
.save-status.err { color:#c0392b; }
.uei-block.voted { box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #cdead6 inset; }
```

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(htmltools)
})

# ---- load -----------------------------------------------------------------
d <- read.csv(params$data_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
d <- d[, !duplicated(names(d)), drop = FALSE]   # drop repeated identical columns

# normalize a few types
istrue <- function(x) x %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE", "True", "true", 1, "1")
d$is_gt_ein_b     <- istrue(d$is_gt_ein)
d$is_top_cand_b   <- istrue(d$is_top_candidate)
d$veto_b          <- istrue(d$veto)
d$veto_soft_b     <- istrue(d$veto_soft)
d$BMF_is_found_b  <- istrue(d$BMF_is_foundation)

# ---- filter to the review pool -------------------------------------------
dec <- toupper(trimws(unlist(strsplit(params$decision_filter, ","))))
if (!("ALL" %in% dec)) d <- d[toupper(d$match_decision) %in% dec, , drop = FALSE]

uei_order <- unique(d$uei)

# per-UEI: does the ground-truth EIN appear among the surfaced candidates?
has_gt <- tapply(d$is_gt_ein_b, d$uei, any)
if (isTRUE(params$only_missing_gt)) {
  keep <- names(has_gt)[!has_gt]
  uei_order <- uei_order[uei_order %in% keep]
}

VOTING <- isTRUE(params$enable_voting)
BLIND  <- isTRUE(params$blind)

# cap (deterministic sample if truncating)
cap <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(params$max_ueis))
truncated <- FALSE
if (!is.na(cap) && cap > 0 && length(uei_order) > cap) {
  set.seed(params$seed)
  uei_order <- sort(sample(uei_order, cap))
  truncated <- TRUE
}
```

```{r helpers}
esc <- function(x) htmltools::htmlEscape(as.character(x))
blank <- function(x) is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) ||
  trimws(as.character(x)) %in% c("", "NA", "none", "None")

# a labelled value cell: field-name on top, value below
cell <- function(fieldname, value_html, empty = FALSE) {
  if (is.null(fieldname)) return("")
  cls <- if (empty) "fv empty" else "fv"
  sprintf('<div class="fld"><span class="fn">%s</span><span class="%s">%s</span></div>',
          esc(fieldname), cls, value_html)
}
# helpers that return the inner value html (or a muted dash)
v_txt <- function(x) if (blank(x)) '&mdash;' else esc(x)
v_mono <- function(x) {
  if (blank(x)) '<span class="empty">&mdash;</span>'
  else sprintf('<span class="mono">%s</span>', esc(x))
}

v_money <- function(x) {
  if (blank(x)) return('&mdash;')
  n <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (is.na(n)) return(esc(x))
  paste0("$", formatC(round(n), format = "d", big.mark = ","))
}
v_year <- function(x) if (blank(x)) '&mdash;' else esc(sub("\\..*$", "", as.character(x)))
v_samdate <- function(x) {          # YYYYMMDD integer -> YYYY-MM-DD
  if (blank(x)) return('&mdash;')
  s <- gsub("[^0-9]", "", as.character(x))
  if (nchar(s) == 8) sprintf("%s-%s-%s", substr(s,1,4), substr(s,5,6), substr(s,7,8)) else esc(x)
}
v_url <- function(x) {
  if (blank(x)) return('&mdash;')
  href <- as.character(x); if (!grepl("^https?://", href)) href <- paste0("http://", href)
  sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>', esc(href), esc(x))
}
v_bool <- function(x, yes = "Yes", no = "No") {
  if (blank(x)) return('&mdash;')
  if (istrue(x)) sprintf('<span class="badge yes">%s</span>', yes)
  else sprintf('<span class="badge neutral">%s</span>', no)
}
v_flag <- function(x) {             # match_version_* etc. as a chip
  if (blank(x)) return('<span class="badge neutral">none</span>')
  sprintf('<span class="badge flag">%s</span>', esc(x))
}
v_conf <- function(x) {             # gt_confidence -> colored badge
  if (blank(x)) return('&mdash;')
  cls <- switch(tolower(as.character(x)), high = "yes", medium = "maybe", low = "no", "neutral")
  sprintf('<span class="badge %s">%s</span>', cls, esc(x))
}
v_subsection <- function(x) {       # 3 -> 501C_3
  if (blank(x)) return('&mdash;')
  esc(paste0("501C_", sub("\\..*$", "", as.character(x))))
}
v_poc <- function(first, mid, last) {  # combine POC name parts, skipping blanks / "(" placeholder
  parts <- c(first, mid, last)
  keep <- !vapply(parts, function(p) blank(p) || trimws(as.character(p)) %in% c("(", ")"), logical(1))
  parts <- trimws(as.character(parts[keep]))
  if (length(parts) == 0) return('&mdash;')
  esc(paste(parts, collapse = " "))
}
v_score <- function(x) {            # 0..1 with a colored bar
  if (blank(x)) return('&mdash;')
  n <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)); if (is.na(n)) return(esc(x))
  cls <- if (n >= .85) "sc-hi" else if (n >= .60) "sc-mid" else "sc-lo"
  sprintf('<div class="bar-wrap"><span class="bar-num">%.2f</span><span class="bar"><span class="%s" style="width:%.0f%%"></span></span></div>',
          n, cls, max(0, min(100, n*100)))
}
dec_badge <- function(x) {
  cls <- switch(toupper(x %||% ""), YES="yes", NO="no", MAYBE="maybe", "neutral")
  sprintf('<span class="badge %s">%s</span>', cls, esc(x %||% "—"))
}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || is.na(a)) b else a
```

```{r render, results='asis'}
# -------- report-level summary --------
pool_ueis   <- uei_order
n_ueis      <- length(pool_ueis)
n_missing   <- sum(!has_gt[names(has_gt) %in% pool_ueis])
n_found     <- n_ueis - n_missing
dec_tab     <- table(toupper(tapply(d$match_decision, d$uei, `[`, 1)[pool_ueis]))

cat('<div class="summary-grid">')
cat(sprintf('<div class="summary-card"><div class="n">%d</div><div class="lbl">UEIs in report</div></div>', n_ueis))
cat(sprintf('<div class="summary-card"><div class="n">%d</div><div class="lbl">Ground-truth EIN present</div></div>', n_found))
cat(sprintf('<div class="summary-card"><div class="n">%d</div><div class="lbl">Ground-truth EIN missing / no match</div></div>', n_missing))
for (dnm in names(dec_tab))
  cat(sprintf('<div class="summary-card"><div class="n">%d</div><div class="lbl">decision = %s</div></div>',
              as.integer(dec_tab[[dnm]]), dnm))
cat('</div>')

cat(sprintf('<p style="color:#777;font-size:.9em"><em>Filter: decision = <b>%s</b>%s. Source: <code>%s</code>.%s Within each UEI the ground-truth candidate (<code>is_gt_ein</code>) is shown first, then the remaining candidates by descending <code>total_score</code>.</em></p>',
  esc(params$decision_filter),
  if (isTRUE(params$only_missing_gt)) ", only UEIs with a missing ground-truth EIN" else "",
  esc(basename(params$data_path)),
  if (truncated) sprintf(" Showing a random sample of %d UEIs (seed %s).", n_ueis, esc(params$seed)) else ""))

# gt_outcome_class -> human-readable banner
banner_for <- function(cls, notes) {
  cls <- tolower(cls %||% "")
  msg <- switch(cls,
    "in_bmf_match"        = list("miss",     "Correct EIN exists in the BMF but was <b>not surfaced</b> as a candidate. This is a recall miss — review the candidate generator."),
    "nonprofit_not_in_bmf"= list("expected", "No candidate expected: the organization is a nonprofit that is <b>not in the BMF</b>."),
    "not_a_nonprofit"     = list("expected", "No candidate expected: the entity is <b>not a nonprofit</b>."),
    "no_match_or_na"      = list("expected", "No match recorded for this UEI."),
    "cant_determine"      = list("undet",    "Ground truth could <b>not be determined</b> for this UEI."),
    list("undet", sprintf("No ground-truth EIN among the candidates (outcome: <code>%s</code>).", esc(cls))))
  extra <- if (!blank(notes)) sprintf(" <span style=\"opacity:.8\">Reviewer note: %s</span>", esc(notes)) else ""
  sprintf('<div class="banner %s"><b>NO GROUND-TRUTH MATCH.</b> %s%s</div>', msg[[1]], msg[[2]], extra)
}

# ---- the matching form for a single candidate row ----
# hide_match=TRUE drops the pipeline's own verdict (decision/score/reason/veto)
# so it can't anchor an independent reviewer in blind mode.
render_form <- function(r, hide_match = FALSE) {
  # r is a one-row data.frame
  row <- function(sec, a, b, c = NULL, d2 = NULL) {
    tds <- paste0(
      sprintf('<td class="sec">%s</td>', if (is.null(sec)) "" else esc(sec)),
      sprintf('<td>%s</td>', a),
      sprintf('<td>%s</td>', b),
      sprintf('<td>%s</td>', c %||% ""),
      sprintf('<td>%s</td>', d2 %||% ""))
    paste0("<tr>", tds, "</tr>")
  }
  html <- paste0(
    '<table class="mf">',
    '<tr><th></th><th>USA&nbsp;Spending&nbsp;/&nbsp;source</th><th>IRS&nbsp;BMF&nbsp;(EO)&nbsp;/&nbsp;SAM</th><th>compare&nbsp;/&nbsp;flags</th><th></th></tr>',

    row("id",
        cell("uei", v_mono(r$uei)),
        cell("ein", v_mono(r$ein))),

    row("name",
        cell("name_uss_raw_main", v_txt(r$name_uss_raw_main)),
        cell("name_bmf_raw_main", v_txt(r$name_bmf_raw_main))),
    row(NULL,
        cell("name_uss_raw_dba", v_txt(r$name_uss_raw_dba), empty = blank(r$name_uss_raw_dba)),
        cell("name_bmf_raw_dba", v_txt(r$name_bmf_raw_dba), empty = blank(r$name_bmf_raw_dba)),
        cell("match_version_bmf", v_flag(r$match_version_bmf))),
    row(NULL,
        cell("name_uss_raw_division", v_txt(r$name_uss_raw_division), empty = blank(r$name_uss_raw_division)),
        "",
        cell("match_version_uss", v_flag(r$match_version_uss))),

    row("nonprofit type",
        cell("BMF_subsection", v_subsection(r$BMF_subsection)),
        cell("BMF_is_foundation", v_bool(r$BMF_is_foundation)),
        cell("bmf_active", v_bool(r$bmf_active))),
    row(NULL,
        cell("SAM_entity_structure_label", v_txt(r$SAM_entity_structure_label)),
        cell("SAM_entity_url", v_url(r$SAM_entity_url))),

    row("age",
        cell("BMF_rule_year", v_year(r$BMF_rule_year)),
        cell("SAM_entity_start_date", v_samdate(r$SAM_entity_start_date))),

    row("size",
        cell("BMF_assets", v_money(r$BMF_assets)),
        cell("BMF_revenue", v_money(r$BMF_revenue)),
        cell("BMF_form_990", v_txt(r$BMF_form_990))),

    row("affiliate",
        cell("BMF_affiliation", v_txt(r$BMF_affiliation)),
        cell("BMF_group_exemption_number", v_txt(r$BMF_group_exemption_number))),

    row("address",
        cell("street_uss", v_txt(r$street_uss)),
        cell("street_bmf", v_txt(r$street_bmf))),
    row(NULL, cell("city_uss", v_txt(r$city_uss)), cell("city_bmf", v_txt(r$city_bmf))),
    row(NULL, cell("state_uss", v_txt(r$state_uss)), cell("state_bmf", v_txt(r$state_bmf))),
    row(NULL, cell("zip5_uss", v_mono(r$zip5_uss)), cell("zip5_bmf", v_mono(r$zip5_bmf))),

    row("point of contact",
        cell("BMF_in_care_of", v_txt(r$BMF_in_care_of)),
        cell("SAM_poc (first middle last)",
             v_poc(r$SAM_poc_first_name, r$SAM_poc_middle_initial, r$SAM_poc_last_name))),

    if (hide_match) "" else paste0(
      row("match score",
          cell("total_score", v_score(r$total_score)),
          cell("match_decision", dec_badge(r$match_decision)),
          cell("labeled_by", v_txt(r$labeled_by))),
      row(NULL,
          cell("name_similarity", v_score(r$name_similarity)),
          cell("addr_similarity", v_score(r$addr_similarity))),
      row(NULL,
          cell("match_layer", v_flag(r$match_layer)),
          cell("decision_reason", v_txt(r$decision_reason))),
      row(NULL,
          cell("veto", if (r$veto_b) '<span class="badge veto">vetoed</span>' else v_bool(FALSE, no="no")),
          cell("veto_reason", v_txt(r$veto_reason), empty = blank(r$veto_reason))),
      row(NULL,
          cell("veto_soft", if (r$veto_soft_b) '<span class="badge soft">soft veto</span>' else v_bool(FALSE, no="no")),
          cell("veto_soft_reason", v_txt(r$veto_soft_reason), empty = blank(r$veto_soft_reason))),
      if (!blank(r$notes))
        sprintf('<tr><td class="sec">notes</td><td colspan="4">%s</td></tr>', esc(r$notes))
      else ""),
    '</table>')
  html
}

# attribute-safe quoting for HTML data-* attributes
attr_esc <- function(x) gsub('"', '&quot;', esc(x %||% ""))

# -------- per-UEI sections --------
for (u in pool_ueis) {
  sub <- d[d$uei == u, , drop = FALSE]
  if (BLIND) {
    # blind: order by score only, do not reveal the ground-truth position
    ord <- order(-suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub$total_score)))
  } else {
    # order: GT first, then by total_score desc
    ord <- order(!sub$is_gt_ein_b, -suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub$total_score)))
  }
  sub <- sub[ord, , drop = FALSE]
  head1 <- sub[1, , drop = FALSE]

  cat(sprintf('<div class="uei-block" data-uei="%s">', attr_esc(u)))
  cat('<div class="uei-head">')
  cat(sprintf('<span class="uei-name">%s</span>', esc(head1$name_uss_raw_main %||% "(no name)")))
  cat(sprintf('<span class="uei-id">UEI %s</span>', esc(u)))
  if (!BLIND) cat(sprintf('&nbsp; <span class="uei-conf">gt_confidence:</span> %s', v_conf(head1$gt_confidence)))
  cat(sprintf('<span class="badge neutral">%d candidate%s</span>',
              nrow(sub), if (nrow(sub) == 1) "" else "s"))
  cat('</div>')

  gt_here <- any(sub$is_gt_ein_b)
  if (!BLIND) {
    if (gt_here) {
      cat('<div class="banner found"><b>GROUND-TRUTH MATCH PRESENT.</b> The correct EIN is among the candidates below (highlighted).</div>')
    } else {
      cat(banner_for(head1$gt_outcome_class, head1$gt_notes))
    }
  } else {
    cat('<div class="banner expected">Review each candidate below and mark whether it is the correct match.</div>')
  }

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sub))) {
    r <- sub[i, , drop = FALSE]
    is_gt   <- isTRUE(r$is_gt_ein_b)
    is_pick <- isTRUE(r$is_top_cand_b)
    show_gt <- is_gt && !BLIND
    cat(sprintf('<div class="cand%s">', if (show_gt) " gt" else ""))
    cat('<div class="cand-head">')
    cat(sprintf('<span class="ttl">Candidate %d of %d</span>', i, nrow(sub)))
    if (show_gt)          cat(' <span class="badge gt">ground truth</span>')
    if (is_pick && !BLIND) cat(' <span class="badge pick">pipeline pick</span>')
    cat(sprintf(' <span class="badge neutral">EIN %s</span>', esc(r$ein %||% "—")))
    cat('</div>')
    cat(render_form(r, hide_match = BLIND))

    if (VOTING) {
      # data-* payload for this candidate; is_gt only embedded when NOT blind
      cat(sprintf(paste0(
        '<div class="vote" data-uei="%s" data-ein="%s" data-idx="%d" data-ncand="%d"',
        ' data-gt="%s" data-decision="%s" data-nameuss="%s" data-namebmf="%s" data-score="%s">'),
        attr_esc(u), attr_esc(r$ein), i, nrow(sub),
        if (BLIND) "" else (if (is_gt) "1" else "0"),
        if (BLIND) "" else attr_esc(r$match_decision),
        attr_esc(r$name_uss_raw_main), attr_esc(r$name_bmf_raw_main),
        attr_esc(r$total_score)))
      cat('<span class="vote-q">Is this the correct match?</span>')
      cat('<button class="vb yes" data-v="yes">Yes</button>')
      cat('<button class="vb no" data-v="no">No</button>')
      cat('<button class="vb maybe" data-v="maybe">Maybe</button>')
      cat('</div>')
    }
    cat('</div>')  # .cand
  }

  if (VOTING) {
    cat(sprintf('<div class="uei-vote" data-uei="%s">', attr_esc(u)))
    cat('<textarea class="uei-notes" placeholder="Notes for this UEI (optional)"></textarea>')
    cat('<button class="save-uei">Save UEI vote</button>')
    cat('<span class="save-status"></span>')
    cat('</div>')
  }
  cat('</div>')  # .uei-block
}
```

```{r vote-ui, results='asis'}
if (VOTING) {
  endpoint <- as.character(params$vote_endpoint %||% "")
  # sticky reviewer/progress bar injected at top of the document body
  cat('<div id="vote-bar">')
  cat('<span class="who">Reviewer:</span> <input type="text" id="reviewer-name" placeholder="your name or initials" autocomplete="off">')
  cat('<button id="save-reviewer">Set</button>')
  cat('<div id="vote-progress"><div class="bar"><span></span></div><div class="lbl">0 of 0 UEIs saved</div></div>')
  cat('<button id="export-csv">Download my votes (CSV)</button>')
  cat('</div>')

  # JS: reviewer identity, localStorage persistence, POST to endpoint, progress, CSV export
  cat(sprintf('<script>\n(function(){\n"use strict";\nvar ENDPOINT = %s;\n',
      paste0('"', gsub('"','\\\\"', endpoint), '"')))
  cat(r"---(
var LS = "mrr:store";
function reviewer(){ return (document.getElementById("reviewer-name").value||"").trim(); }
function store(){ try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS)||"{}"); } catch(e){ return {}; } }
function saveStore(s){ localStorage.setItem(LS, JSON.stringify(s)); }
function who(){ return reviewer() || "_anon"; }
function bucket(){ var s=store(); var w=who(); if(!s[w]) s[w]={}; return s; }

// move the sticky bar to the very top of the article body
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
  var bar=document.getElementById("vote-bar");
  var main=document.querySelector("main")||document.body;
  main.insertBefore(bar, main.firstChild);

  // restore reviewer name
  var savedName = localStorage.getItem("mrr:reviewer");
  if(savedName) document.getElementById("reviewer-name").value = savedName;

  restoreAll();
  updateProgress();

  document.getElementById("save-reviewer").addEventListener("click", function(){
    localStorage.setItem("mrr:reviewer", reviewer());
    restoreAll(); updateProgress();
  });
  document.getElementById("reviewer-name").addEventListener("change", function(){
    localStorage.setItem("mrr:reviewer", reviewer()); restoreAll(); updateProgress();
  });
  document.getElementById("export-csv").addEventListener("click", exportCSV);

  // vote button clicks (event delegation)
  document.querySelectorAll(".vote").forEach(function(v){
    v.querySelectorAll(".vb").forEach(function(b){
      b.addEventListener("click", function(){
        var on = b.classList.contains("on");
        v.querySelectorAll(".vb").forEach(function(x){ x.classList.remove("on"); });
        if(!on) b.classList.add("on");
        persistCand(v);
      });
    });
  });
  // notes persistence
  document.querySelectorAll(".uei-vote").forEach(function(uv){
    var ta = uv.querySelector(".uei-notes");
    ta.addEventListener("input", function(){
      var s=bucket(), w=who(), uei=uv.getAttribute("data-uei");
      if(!s[w][uei]) s[w][uei]={cands:{}};
      s[w][uei].notes = ta.value; saveStore(s);
    });
    uv.querySelector(".save-uei").addEventListener("click", function(){ saveUEI(uv); });
  });
});

function persistCand(v){
  var s=bucket(), w=who();
  var uei=v.getAttribute("data-uei"), ein=v.getAttribute("data-ein");
  var chosen=null; v.querySelectorAll(".vb").forEach(function(x){ if(x.classList.contains("on")) chosen=x.getAttribute("data-v"); });
  if(!s[w][uei]) s[w][uei]={cands:{}};
  if(!s[w][uei].cands) s[w][uei].cands={};
  if(chosen===null) delete s[w][uei].cands[ein]; else s[w][uei].cands[ein]=chosen;
  saveStore(s);
}

function restoreAll(){
  var s=bucket(), w=who();
  document.querySelectorAll(".vote").forEach(function(v){
    var uei=v.getAttribute("data-uei"), ein=v.getAttribute("data-ein");
    var val = s[w][uei] && s[w][uei].cands ? s[w][uei].cands[ein] : null;
    v.querySelectorAll(".vb").forEach(function(x){ x.classList.toggle("on", x.getAttribute("data-v")===val); });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll(".uei-vote").forEach(function(uv){
    var uei=uv.getAttribute("data-uei");
    uv.querySelector(".uei-notes").value = (s[w][uei] && s[w][uei].notes) || "";
    var block=uv.closest(".uei-block");
    if(block) block.classList.toggle("voted", !!(s[w][uei] && s[w][uei].saved));
    var st=uv.querySelector(".save-status");
    st.className="save-status"; st.textContent = (s[w][uei] && s[w][uei].saved) ? ("saved "+s[w][uei].saved.replace("T"," ").slice(0,16)) : "";
  });
}

function rowsForUEI(uv){
  var uei=uv.getAttribute("data-uei");
  var rows=[]; var nowIso=new Date().toISOString();
  document.querySelectorAll('.vote[data-uei="'+cssEsc(uei)+'"]').forEach(function(v){
    var chosen=null; v.querySelectorAll(".vb").forEach(function(x){ if(x.classList.contains("on")) chosen=x.getAttribute("data-v"); });
    if(chosen===null) return;
    rows.push({
      client_ts: nowIso, reviewer: reviewer(), uei: uei, ein: v.getAttribute("data-ein"),
      cand_index: v.getAttribute("data-idx"), num_candidates: v.getAttribute("data-ncand"),
      is_gt_ein: v.getAttribute("data-gt"), pipeline_decision: v.getAttribute("data-decision"),
      name_uss: v.getAttribute("data-nameuss"), name_bmf: v.getAttribute("data-namebmf"),
      total_score: v.getAttribute("data-score"), vote: chosen,
      notes: uv.querySelector(".uei-notes").value || ""
    });
  });
  return rows;
}

function saveUEI(uv){
  var st=uv.querySelector(".save-status");
  if(!reviewer()){ st.className="save-status err"; st.textContent="enter your name first \u2191"; return; }
  var rows=rowsForUEI(uv);
  if(rows.length===0){ st.className="save-status err"; st.textContent="mark at least one candidate"; return; }
  // mark saved locally first (source of truth is the CSV export + localStorage)
  var s=bucket(), w=who(), uei=uv.getAttribute("data-uei");
  if(!s[w][uei]) s[w][uei]={cands:{}};
  s[w][uei].saved=new Date().toISOString(); saveStore(s);
  restoreAll(); updateProgress();
  if(!ENDPOINT){ st.className="save-status"; st.textContent="saved locally (no endpoint set)"; return; }
  st.className="save-status"; st.textContent="sending\u2026";
  fetch(ENDPOINT, {method:"POST", mode:"no-cors",
    headers:{"Content-Type":"text/plain;charset=utf-8"}, body: JSON.stringify(rows)})
    .then(function(){ st.className="save-status"; st.textContent="saved \u2713"; })
    .catch(function(){ st.className="save-status err"; st.textContent="save failed \u2014 kept locally; use Download CSV"; });
}

function updateProgress(){
  var s=bucket(), w=who();
  var blocks=document.querySelectorAll(".uei-block[data-uei]");
  var total=blocks.length, done=0;
  blocks.forEach(function(b){ var u=b.getAttribute("data-uei"); if(s[w][u] && s[w][u].saved) done++; });
  var pct= total? Math.round(done/total*100):0;
  document.querySelector("#vote-progress .bar > span").style.width = pct+"%";
  document.querySelector("#vote-progress .lbl").textContent = done+" of "+total+" UEIs saved ("+pct+"%)";
}

function csvCell(x){ x=(x==null?"":String(x)); return '"'+x.replace(/"/g,'""')+'"'; }
function exportCSV(){
  var s=bucket(), w=who();
  var hdr=["client_ts","reviewer","uei","ein","cand_index","num_candidates","is_gt_ein","pipeline_decision","name_uss","name_bmf","total_score","vote","notes","saved"];
  var lines=[hdr.map(csvCell).join(",")];
  document.querySelectorAll(".uei-vote").forEach(function(uv){
    var uei=uv.getAttribute("data-uei"); var saved=(s[w][uei]&&s[w][uei].saved)||"";
    rowsForUEI(uv).forEach(function(r){
      lines.push([r.client_ts,r.reviewer,r.uei,r.ein,r.cand_index,r.num_candidates,r.is_gt_ein,r.pipeline_decision,r.name_uss,r.name_bmf,r.total_score,r.vote,r.notes,saved].map(csvCell).join(","));
    });
  });
  var blob=new Blob([lines.join("\n")],{type:"text/csv"});
  var a=document.createElement("a"); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download="match-votes-"+(reviewer()||"anon").replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g,"_")+".csv";
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
}
function cssEsc(x){ return (window.CSS&&CSS.escape)?CSS.escape(x):x.replace(/["\\]/g,"\\$&"); }
})();
</script>)---")
}
```
